description: Source code for a Git credential helper using libsecret to store and retrieve credentials from the GNOME Keyring, including functions for get, store, and erase operations, credential data structure, and main program logic.

classes.name: credential
classes.description: Data structure representing credentials including protocol, host, port, path, username, password, expiry, and refresh token.

classes.name: credential_operation
classes.description: Structure representing a credential operation with a name and callback function.

methods.name: make_label
methods.description: Creates a label string for a credential based on protocol, host, port, and path.

methods.name: make_attr_list
methods.description: Constructs a hash table of attributes from a credential for searching/storing in the keyring.

methods.name: keyring_get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from the keyring based on provided credential info.

methods.name: keyring_store
methods.description: Stores credentials into the keyring with associated attributes.

methods.name: keyring_erase
methods.description: Removes credentials from the keyring matching the provided credential pattern.

methods.name: credential_init
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure to default values.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for credential fields and reinitializes the structure.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from stdin input.

methods.name: credential_write_item
methods.description: Outputs a key-value pair to stdout.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Outputs credential data (username, password, expiry, refresh token) to stdout.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the credential helper.
